title: Research v1
description: Output of the researcher subagent. One file per scout call, written to .claude/state/handoff-researcher-{scope}[-{wi_id}].json. The conductor dispatches researcher in parallel during the design phase and sequentially per-WI during the implementation phase; designer and developer consume these files as read-only inputs.

scope.description: Which slice of the codebase or external surface this scout covered. feature-scout: most similar existing feature folder. data-scout: DbSets, entity configs, indexes, relationships. infra-scout: IFeatureConfiguration, AuthorizationPolicies, shared validators. library-cheatsheet: external API/library usage for a single developer WI.

target.description: Free-text description of what was scouted, e.g. 'Orders feature folder', 'PlanCell entity + related configs', 'GraphServiceClient calendar API'.

wi_id.description: Only set for scope=library-cheatsheet. Identifies which WI this research supports.

code_refs.description: Concrete file:line or symbol references inside the repo.

doc_refs.description: External documentation URLs (Microsoft Learn, vendor docs, context7).

snippet.description: Optional short code snippet illustrating the call-site / pattern.

usable.description: Self-assessment by the researcher. false when Haiku could not produce >= 3 concrete refs OR no call-site example OR responded 'could not find' without trying an alternative query. Conductor re-dispatches the same prompt with model: sonnet when usable=false.

model_used.description: Which model produced this output. Conductor sets the model when dispatching; researcher echoes it back so the quality guard can trigger an upgrade.

notes.description: Free-form caveats, gaps, or follow-up suggestions for the downstream consumer.

examples.target: Most similar existing feature to the target slice

findings.summary: Follow the IFeatureConfiguration contract and the vertical-slice layout from rules/architecture.md: request, endpoint, models, and validators co-located in one Features/{Name}/ folder.
